meta.description: An utterance analysis fails (fallback also fails) and the end-of-session summary compression fails; the pipeline must degrade the same way.

events.question_text: Explain how a hash map handles collisions.

events.text: How does a hash map deal with two keys that hash to the same bucket?
You can chain entries in a list per bucket or use open addressing and probe for the next free slot. [scripted-fail:utterance_analysis]
With chaining, lookups degrade to linear time in the worst case if many keys collide in one bucket.
Java switches long chains to balanced trees to bound that at log n. [scripted-fail:summary]
